title: Symmetry and generation
summary: The manuscript An Inquiry into Chemical Structure Generation through Symmetry Breaking (v1.4), made exact: its group-equivariant grammar and its group-field-inspired complexes, executed and verified, with a note on what the revision should change.

views.title: Grammar
views.about: Formalism I: typed graph grammars by double pushout, their derivations, orbits and accounting.

views.title: Stereocentre
views.about: Case Study I in three dimensions: the two configurations of CHBrClF, τ and its CIP descriptor.

views.title: Point groups
views.about: Molecules, their point groups, character tables and the responses symmetry allows.

views.title: Selection
views.about: Frank's autocatalysis as mass action and as a Markov chain: a symmetric law with asymmetric outcomes.

views.title: Complexes
views.about: Case Study II: the six-cycle, its filled complex, and the two-vertex complex with their homology.

views.title: Field
views.about: Formalism II: the tetrahedral interaction over a finite group, its symmetries, order parameters and Feynman graphs.

source: Wanhong Huang, An Inquiry into Chemical Structure Generation through Symmetry Breaking: Two Formalisms Drawing on Group-Equivariant Grammar and Group Field Theory, manuscript v1.4 (2026-10-28)
